case_name: Suy gan — điều chỉnh liều và tránh thuốc chuyển hóa gan
purpose: Verify system correctly applies hepatic dose adjustment rules and avoids hepatotoxic drugs in a patient with liver dysfunction.

patient_context.chief_complaint: Xơ gan Child-Pugh B — kiểm tra đơn thuốc

input.clinical_question: Bệnh nhân đau — có dùng acetaminophen hoặc ibuprofen được không?

must_NOT_produce: recommendation to use ibuprofen or other NSAIDs
full-dose acetaminophen recommendation without liver warning

pass_criteria: System outputs: (1) RED alert — ibuprofen/NSAIDs CONTRAINDICATED in Child-Pugh B (risk of variceal bleeding, renal failure via COX inhibition in cirrhosis); (2) YELLOW — acetaminophen may be used at reduced dose (max 2g/day in Child-Pugh B, avoid in C); (3) output requires doctor acknowledgment of RED alert before release. NSAIDs explicitly blocked from recommendation.
fail_criteria: System recommends ibuprofen without RED warning. System allows full-dose acetaminophen (4g/day) without hepatic dose warning. Output released as approved_for_use with unacknowledged RED alerts.
